title: The Spirit Bathhouse
subtitle: Live class · Basic math (addition and subtraction)
story: The great spirit bathhouse's biggest tub is filthy, and only bundles of magic bath herbs can clean it. Solve a sum in any room to pick up a herb bundle and carry it to the big tub until it is clean. Side quests earn points too: spend bath tokens from the token stall and the wardrobe to fill the small baths, hang robes on the robe rack, decorate the ofrenda, and win once the tub is clean and you have enough side quest points. Fun!
